Behind her is a light beige fabric couch featuring a white pillow with a "YouTube" logo. A large window in the background reveals a city view with architectural structures under bright, natural daylight. (2) The camera switches to a closer medium shot, focusing on her upper body and face. She makes various hand gestures to emphasize her words, specifically raising her right hand to show four fingers while discussing a monetary figure. Her facial expressions convey skepticism and shock, with raised eyebrows and a slightly pouting mouth. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting her facial features and the texture of her yellow dress. (3) The woman continues her storytelling, gesturing towards her head and ears as she quotes a second individual. Her posture remains seated on the floor, and she occasionally glances down at the papers in her hand before looking back up at the viewer. The background environment remains consistent, showing the indoor living space and the blurred city scene outside the window. The phase ends with her widening her eyes in an exaggerated expression of shock.
